<fidel-code-snapshots>

Code in sync with the video. Lists code blocks in time order; while the video plays, the current one shows "Now" and is announced once.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Blind learners following a coding video where the teacher types code on screen.

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት።

<h1>My first page</h1>
 
<h1>My first page</h1>
<p>Hello, world.</p>

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<fidel-code-snapshots for="lesson-player">
  <fidel-code-block at="0:45" language="html" label="Step 1">
<pre><code>&lt;h1&gt;My first page&lt;/h1&gt;</code></pre>
  </fidel-code-block>
  <fidel-code-block at="1:23" language="html" label="Step 2">
<pre><code>&lt;h1&gt;My first page&lt;/h1&gt;
&lt;p&gt;Hello, world.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre>
  </fidel-code-block>
</fidel-code-snapshots>

Source: player/src/components/a/code-snapshots.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-code-snapshots>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
forid of a <fidel-player>the first <fidel-player>The player to follow.
ui-langen, amthe page's lang, else enLanguage of the component's own buttons and messages.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

Events sent by <fidel-code-snapshots>
Eventevent.detailWhen
fidel-code-snapshots-change{ index, seconds }Another snapshot became current.

Events bubble and carry no personal data. Listen with addEventListener, like any DOM event.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • Each snapshot is a <fidel-code-block> with its own Copy, Read line by line and "Play from" buttons.
  • When the video reaches a snapshot, a screen reader hears "Code for 0:59 is ready" once; never while the learner seeks.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Its own buttons and messages are in English or Amharic. Set ui-lang="am" on the tag (or on a parent); without it, the page's lang is used, else English.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 1.4.1 Use of Color: The current snapshot has a bar, a tint and the word "Now".
  • 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value: aria-current="time" on the current snapshot.
  • 4.1.3 Status Messages: "Code for 1:23 is ready", once per snapshot.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
